overview.title: Real scenarios built into the structure
overview.description: A climbing tower is not just a building — it's a tactical training system. We co-design positions and flows with your unit so every drill reflects real operational scenarios.
overview.lead: Multi-story structure + configurable entry points supporting the full tactical chain from unassisted climbing to team assault.
overview.body: All-galvanized steel ensures rugged reliability under high-frequency use, with guardrails and fall-arrest systems protecting training safety.

features.title: Multi-Level Climbing Structure
features.desc: Multi-story layout replicating real buildings — unassisted climbing, rapid ascent, and floor-by-floor movement.

features.title: Rappelling & High Transfer
features.desc: Pre-installed rope anchors and work platforms for rappelling, descent, and high traverse disciplines.

features.title: Tactical Entry Scenarios
features.desc: Breach doors, windows, and balconies configurable to tactical entry flows.

features.title: Custom Floor Plans
features.desc: Rooms, corridors, and positions customized to unit tactical requirements and operational flows.

features.title: Team Coordination
features.desc: Multi-level, multi-point design supporting team coordination, command, and force-on-force drills.

features.title: Built to Last
features.desc: All-galvanized steel structure — impact and weather resistant under high-frequency climbing and equipment use.
